label: t10_orien_01_01
text: Welcome to Mossui Town! We’re known for our\napples and for the natural beauty all around us!

label: t10_orien_05_01
text: You’re here on some kind of school field trip, eh?\nNo wonder you kids didn’t look familiar!

label: t10_orien_07_01
text: Are the festival preparations going OK? We’re\nstarting to fall behind on our merch deliveries...

label: t10_orien_08_01
text: I’ve been perfecting my fried noodle recipe by\npracticing at home every day!

label: t10_orien_09_01
text:
Peachy’s is such a handy shop to have around!\c
Sure, they’ve got all your item needs covered.
But more importantly, the little old lady who runs
the place knits THE warmest socks ever!

label: t10_orien_11_01
text: Kitakami Hall is just up this hill!\c\nWell, I guess it’s more of a mountain...but\nwhatever you call it, it’s all uphill from here!

label: t10_orien_14_01
text: Looking at Poliwag’s belly makes me dizzy!

label: t10_orien_23_01
text: Carmine and Kieran both got into a school in\nsome far-off region!

label: t10_orien_24_01
text: Is it true? Are those rowdy siblings back in town?

label: t10_orien_28_01
text: Once the rice fields turn nice and golden, they’ll\nbe ready for harvesting!

label: t10_orien_32_01
text: Let me get this straight—you put rice IN your\nsandwiches? Don’t see that around Kitakami...

label: t10_orien_34_01
text: Not a whole lot going on in this town, is there?\nThat’s exactly what I like about it!

label: t10_matsuri_01_01
text: This is Mossui Town, known far and wide for its\nFestival of Masks!

label: t10_matsuri_05_01
text: The local youth group is pitching in to make the\nfestivities extra special. We hope you have fun!

label: t10_matsuri_05_02
text: I saw the Loyal Three chowing down on mochi at\nKitakami Hall!

label: t10_matsuri_05_03
text: I heard some kid became friends with Ogerpon!\nI’ll bet it was Kieran.

label: t10_matsuri_07_01
text: I love Okidogi! So green. So cool!

label: t10_matsuri_07_02
text: I got to see Okidogi! The real one wasn’t as\ngreen as the Okidogi masks, though.

label: t10_matsuri_07_03
text: The real Ogerpon’s mask looks just like the masks\nthey sell at the festival—super green!

label: t10_matsuri_11_01
text:
You know those candy apples they sell during the
festival?\c
They’re made using ingredients picked fresh from
the Apple Hills!

label: t10_matsuri_15_01
text: Which came first: the festival or the masks?

label: s1_t10_zombie_npc_01
text: Mochi-mochi!

label: s1_t10_zombie_npc_03
text: Chi-chi-chi mo-mo-mo...

label: s1_t10_zombie_npc_05
text: Mochi... Mochi... Mo...chi...
